source.label: Residual bulk normality and boundary failures

reviewer: Codex with one isolated medium reviewer

claims.summary: For p7,11,13 and all d>=6, D=16d-41,N=8D+8, the actual first conic boundary is (r3+r2+s3+rs3)A_D normally and (r5+r3s3)A_D+(r2+s3)B_D at D5modp, with independent characters,r2=1-t,s2=1+bt,g=r2s4. A_D is the five ordinary rational residue profiles with dyadic pivots. B_D=F_(2D+1) at11,13; at7 it is F_(2D-1) plus the two displayed coupled g-outliers. Complete primitive opposite-point rows have valuations(3,2),(1,0),(0,4). Source profiles depend on Dmodp. Complete marked maps use25 states at7,11 at11,13 at13, sizes<=21, with all actual global powers retained.
claims.assessment: Working full-source classification passed by one isolated medium reviewer. The ordinary dyadic pivots remain valid; direct opposite-point reductions in the actual fields give primitive row divisions(3,2),(1,0),(0,4), all below the retained precision. Independent constant rows prove full saturation. The exact high-index bound8 gives25+11+13 local matrices with all global powers retained. Every finite row and all three complete exceptional-source Hasse comparisons pass.
claims.rationale: Derives actual small-prime exceptional domains and bounded local inventory without reducing through vanishing rational pivots. Extends the established full-source method; no independent novelty claim.
claims.next_action: Use these complete profiles and their exact failures to derive actual elliptic repair in the remaining septenary families.

claims.summary: For every odd prime p, every field of characteristic p and every d>=6, original generic dimension-eight V_(8,d) has Hasse orders0..128d-321, except that p7,d3mod7 or d9mod49 remains unasserted. Forty-four exact local coefficient certificates plus three retained-y identities settle all residual p11,p13 degrees and all other p7 states. Earlier theorems cover p3,p5 and every p>=17. The two exceptions are proof gaps, not original nonnormality claims; low degrees in remaining primes, higher dimensions and pre-stable thresholds remain separate.
claims.assessment: Working residual theorem passed by one isolated medium reviewer. Forty-four exact coefficients have local order below the required7,49,11,13 precision and total residual order at most48<N. Three remaining ordinary dense cases are verified against exact retained-y factors with nonzero cubic residuals. Together with prior full characteristics and the uniform-prime theorem, every odd prime and bulk degree is covered except the two explicitly unasserted septenary families.
claims.rationale: Closes complete bulk ranges at11 and13 and nearly all septenary states, combining them with the uniform-prime proof into one all-odd statement with two precise remaining families. No independent novelty claim for finite-state coefficient checking.
claims.next_action: Derive source-preserving elliptic variation for the p7,d3mod7 family first, with the recorded alternative degree-one core and full moving prefactors; retain the exceptional d9mod49 family in the same task.

claims.summary: In characteristic7 the actual first conic boundary is generically nonnormal for every d>=6,d3mod7: its13-condition determinant vanishes identically in independent global-power variables. The d9mod49 boundary also fails on q=7^(16t+8),d=(q+319)/128,N=q-1,t>=0, since its determinant is divisible by (u2*C+1)Y+u(C-1)X, which vanishes under the actual Frobenius powers. The alternative v->w full conic boundary has consecutive inner blocks and fixed prefactors(r2+r3+s7+rs7) atD0 or(r2+r5+s7+r3s7) atD5; both complete determinants are identically zero. No original nonnormality or uniform exact corank is asserted.
claims.assessment: Working source-obstruction proof passed by one isolated medium reviewer. The first d3mod7 determinant and both alternative D0/D5 determinants are identically zero even with independent global powers. In the d9mod49 state, exact polynomial division and a cleared Frobenius identity prove the displayed infinite actual-power failure. The alternative v->w coordinate transformation retains the whole exceptional domain; a unit top-two opposite-point minor proves its full limit. Sampled coranks are not promoted to uniform corank claims, and no original nonnormality is asserted.
claims.rationale: Finds exact infinite failures in two complete source-preserving formulations, preventing more inconclusive boundary sampling. Positive less-degenerate controls keep the obstruction scoped to sufficient boundaries.
claims.next_action: Return to actual elliptic deformation rather than try to certify these zero boundary determinants; derive the first induced coefficient with full source and pole accounting.

claims.summary: At p7,d10,D119,N960, the actual ordinary elliptic eight-block source has exact full Hasse rank960 at slopes(1,a,a2) over the retained F_(7^4), proving original generic V_(8,10) normal. At p7,d9 the first conic source has rank832, proving original degree-nine normality. The alternative conic source has ranks959/960 atd10 and830/832 atd9, agreeing with its13/17-condition maps. These are exact finite controls, not uniform generic corank statements or all-family repairs.
claims.assessment: Exact finite checks passed by the same isolated medium reviewer. The complete ordinary elliptic matrix atp7,d10 has rank960 at the first retained admissible point. The full first conic matrix atd9 has rank832. Independent alternative full-source matrices have ranks959 and830, agreeing with their bounded maps. Original-source transfers certify only the stated fixed degrees; these calibrate the next actual deformation and are not extrapolated.
claims.rationale: Calibrates the necessary return from two failed boundaries to the actual elliptic source at the smallest ordinary failed family. The full positive source and independent boundary comparisons change the next action; no larger-degree survey.
claims.next_action: Use the nonzero degree-ten elliptic control to test the actual saturated variation on the whole p7,d3mod7 family; do not enlarge the finite sample.
